title: nubjs/nub
claim: nubjs/nub — The fast all-in-one Node.js toolkit
why_good: A fast all-in-one Node.js toolkit — bundles the fragmented JS tooling story, riding the Bun-style 'one tool' appeal.
value: Runtimes/toolkits monetize indirectly (cloud/enterprise); the wedge is speed + a unified DX.
risk: Bun already owns 'fast all-in-one JS'; a newcomer needs a dramatic edge to matter.
pick_reason: Nub offers a clear product that simplifies Node.js development, which can be monetized through subscriptions or licensing.

zh.claim: nubjs/nub —— 快速的 Node.js 一体化工具包。
zh.why_good: 一个快速的 Node.js 一体化工具包——收拢碎片化的 JS 工具链,吃 Bun 式 一个工具搞定 的吸引力。
zh.value: 运行时/工具包靠间接变现(云/企业);切口是速度 + 统一的开发体验。
zh.risk: Bun 已占 快速一体化 JS;后来者需要压倒性优势才有意义。
